title: Among the patients whose total bilirubin is over the normal range, how many
question:
Among the patients whose total bilirubin is over the normal range, how many of them have a peripheral pattern observed in the sheet of ANA examination?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: total bilirubin is over the normal range refers to `T-BIL` > = 2.0; peripheral pattern is observed in the sheet of ANA examination refers to that ANA Pattern contains 'P';

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.XCL_014)
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Examination E ON E.XCL_001 = L.XCL_014
WHERE L.XCL_025 >= 2.0
  AND E.XCL_006 LIKE '%P%';
